findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the two translated goal lines so they preserve the original meaning (fathers/children). For example:

Lengo #1. Kurudisha mioyo ya baba kwa watoto wao.

Lengo #2. Kurudisha mioyo ya watoto kwa baba zao.

findings.location:
Mpango wa Mungu kwa Mwanamume na Mwanamke

Mathayo 12:1 inasema, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.”
findings.source_quote: Ecclesiastes 12:1 says, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.”
findings.suggested_fix:
Correct the book citation to match the source. Replace 'Mathayo 12:1' with 'Mhubiri 12:1' (Swahili name for Ecclesiastes) or leave as 'Ecclesiastes 12:1' if the publication prefers English book names. For example:

Mhubiri 12:1 inasema, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.”
findings.translation_quote: Mathayo 12:1 inasema, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.”

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).
